scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of all-scale overlap and radial ordering; independent polygon clipping is a numerical diagnostic, not a proof of quantified claims.
scientific_limitations: Two concentric regular Euclidean polygons of the same side number, arbitrary positive apothems and relative rotation; no translation, mixed side numbers or high-dimensional claim. Generic intersection-algorithm computations and containment thresholds are known. Historical novelty has unresolved indexing risks, and no independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact scale-and-rotation overlap profile of concentric regular polygons
